summary: Primary City of Syracuse Surveillance Technology Working Group materials from February 10, 2026 record the post-vote Axon ALPR governance state: a February 6 joint committee review where Corporation Counsel Sue Katzoff and SPD Deputy Chief Trudell answered questions about cameras, data collection and sharing; February 9 Common Council approval of revocable right-of-way permission and a 60-month agreement for 26 readers; a $422,636.28 not-to-exceed amount; the first 12 months free; and a mayoral RFP waiver.
